name: Paul Peter
headline: Fullstack Software Engineer focused on scalable web systems
marquee: FULLSTACK SYSTEMS, REAL-TIME APPS, AND PRODUCTION WEB SOLUTIONS
subtext: I build full-stack web applications and backend systems with Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, focused on speed, reliable data architecture, and clear user workflows.

about.content: I got into software engineering because I wanted to build tools that people actually use. Starting out, I wanted to understand how the web worked under the hood, which led me from building frontend layouts to designing backend services, database schemas, and real-time data pipelines.\n\nGood software isn't just about clean visuals; it has to be fast, reliable, and solve real problems without getting in the user's way. Whether I'm building real-time messaging, auth workflows, or API integrations, I focus on predictable state, solid performance, and maintainable code.

hero.quote: Building fast, reliable full-stack applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
